Review the shape

The body, fixed neck and measured component envelopes stay the same. The new tail slides into an asymmetric rear socket; a proposed M3 cross screw and nut hold it in place. Remove the screw and pull the tail straight backward. The Tail joint view separates the pieces by 35 mm to show the key; the screw is omitted.

The tail sits above the lower service openings. Its proposed clearance is 0.4 mm per side; a fit sample and load check are still needed. Review its curve, length and the small frame details before we prepare the final STL print set.

Before creating the final print set

The draft uses your 62 mm wheel diameter and 61 × 20 mm motor length/width. We still need motor height and shaft position, wheel hub fit, caster, AA holder, phone case/camera access, and printer bed/material/nozzle.

Each part needs fit and slicer/support review. The complete robot includes visual stand-ins for bought components; it is not a single object to print. Design approval and physical fit approval are separate steps.
